lines.text: Many learners say: I like very much pizza.
Better: I like pizza very much.
Very much! I like music very much.

native.hook: Você diz “I like very much pizza”?
native.tip: Em inglês, o objeto vem logo depois do verbo: “I like pizza very much”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I like very much pizza.”. O certo é “I like pizza very much.”. Em português dizemos “gosto muito de pizza”, mas a ordem em inglês é outra. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “very much”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I like very much pizza”?
en.tip: In English, the object comes right after the verb: “I like pizza very much”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I like very much pizza.”. The right way is “I like pizza very much.”. In Portuguese we say it another way, but the English order is different. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
